thread:
elaine: heads-up - a few customers hit SSO failures after midnight maintenance. SAML decrypts failing with 'encryption context mismatch'.
tom: which key rotated? alias or raw id?
rachel: alias 'sso-envelope-main' rotated at 00:07 UTC per maintenance.
elaine: sample log: 
```
ERROR: saml: decrypt failed: invalid_encryption_context: expected={tenant:acme,svc:saml,v=1} got={tenant:acme,svc:saml,v=2}
```
tom: looks like the encryption header version changed. any recent lib bumps?
rachel: yeah, we bumped internal package 'envelope-sdk' from 2.0.1 -> 2.1.0 in the same deploy. change notes mention adding a version prefix to context keys.
infra-oncall: deploy-bot shows canary 23:59, promote 00:05. audit-bot: "kms:KeyRotation user=ops-maint alias=sso-envelope-main id=rot-555 ts=2025-01-10T00:07:12Z"
tom: sequence likely: lib changes header format -> new key rotation wrote policy assuming old format -> decrypt fails for cases where contexts don't match.
elaine: mitigation options?
tom: short term: try fallback decrypt attempts with both v1 and v2 contexts in the decrypt path. longer: re-encrypt persisted assertions to canonical format and pin sdk.
rachel: I can revert the sdk bump in the next patch and pin services to 2.0.x. opened ticket SEC-7901 to track re-encrypt work.
infra-oncall: adding metric saml.decrypt_context_mismatch.count and alert >=3 in 5m.
audit-bot: audit: provisional-deploy tom patch try-dual-decrypt ts=2025-01-10T00:35:00Z user=tom
elaine: good. also update runbook: check library changes and jwks/jwe context expectations before any KMS key rotation.
rachel: filing runbook PR now. I'll notify CS for affected tenants and estimate 36h for full re-encrypt.
tom: patch rolled out to prod canary passed. logging will show which context matched so we can scope re-encrypt.
elaine: summary: root cause = encryption context version drift after sdk bump + key rotation; impact = SAML decrypt failures; mitigations = dual-decrypt fallback, sdk pin, re-encrypt job, runbook update. owners: tom (patch + logs), rachel (sdk pin + runbook), infra-oncall (re-encrypt + monitoring).
